# evroc_snapshot (Resource)

Provides an evroc snapshot resource. Snapshots capture the state of a disk at a point in time and can be used to create new disks.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `disk_ref` (String) Reference to the disk to snapshot. Accepts FQID or plain name.
- `name` (String) Name of the snapshot. Must be unique within the project.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project this resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider project.
- `region` (String) Region where the snapshot is created. Defaults to provider region.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the snapshot was created (RFC3339 format).
- `fqid` (String) Fully qualified resource ID (FQID). Use this to reference this resource from other resources.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `restore_size` (Number) Size of the snapshot in GB.
- `snapshot_id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the snapshot.
- `system_labels` (Map of String) System-managed labels automatically set by evroc (read-only).
